items.title: Rotor System: Low-G and Mast Bumping
items.description: The two-blade teetering main rotor's low inertia built up layer by layer, then a real turbulence encounter to show exactly how to recognize and recover from a low-G condition.

items.title: Governor: Throttle Correlator and RPM Management
items.description: How the throttle correlator and RPM governor work together to hold rotor speed, followed through a real governor malfunction to show manual throttle takeover.

items.title: Autorotation: Power-Failure Procedures
items.description: The full power-failure procedure across every altitude band, walked through a real engine failure from recognition to touchdown.

items.title: Drive System: Clutch and Belt Mechanics
items.description: How the belt drive and overrunning clutch actually make autorotation possible, followed through a real in-flight clutch-light event.

items.title: Limitations: Operating Limits
items.description: The full R44 II numbers sheet — airspeed, rotor RPM, engine limits, and weight and CG — as a rapid-fire recap.
